mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pull_task_group_account ( tenant_id, task_id, group_execution_id, account_id, account_phone, role_type, role_seq, source_type, selection_mode, entry_mode, membership_status, admin_status, availability_status, pull_call_id, occupied_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{allocationTenantId}, #{taskId}, #{groupExecutionId}, #{accountId}, #{accountPhone}, #{roleType}, #{roleSeq}, #{sourceType}, #{selectionMode}, #{entryMode}, #{membershipStatus}, #{adminStatus}, #{availabilityStatus}, #{pullCallId}, #{occupiedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_creator_deletion d WHERE (d.account_id=#{accountId} OR d.creator_phone=REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(#{accountPhone}),'+',''),' ','')) AND NOT (d.lifecycle='RESERVED' AND d.tenant_id=#{allocationTenantId} AND d.task_id=#{taskId} AND d.group_execution_id=#{groupExecutionId} AND d.account_id=#{accountId} AND #{roleType}=4))
mapper.update: UPDATE pull_task_group_account SET released_at = NULL, occupied_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND role_type = #{roleType} AND released_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_creator_deletion d WHERE d.account_id=pull_task_group_account.account_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.id=pull_task_group_account.account_id AND a.creator_deletion_identity_phone=d.creator_phone))
mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM account a WHERE a.creator_deletion_identity_phone IN (SELECT route.creator_deletion_identity_phone FROM account route WHERE route.id=#{accountId}) ORDER BY a.id FOR UPDATE
